title: Pure Graydle
summary: Pure Graydle parasitic invasion and mind-control build, featuring extraterrestrial WATER Aquas that hijack opposing monsters. The Level 3 aliens equip to and take control of opponent monsters when destroyed by specific card types, while Graydle Impact and Slime Jr. fuel rampant self-destruction, card advantage, and Level 8 Synchro climbs into Graydle Dragon.

summary.title: Starters & Parasitic Theft
points: Graydle Alligator equips to and takes control of an opponent's face-up monster when destroyed by battle or a Spell effect (such as Graydle Impact).
Graydle Cobra equips to and takes control of an opponent's face-up monster when destroyed by battle or a Trap effect (such as Graydle Split).
Graydle Eagle equips to and takes control of an opponent's face-up monster when destroyed by battle or a monster effect (such as Graydle Slime or Graydle Dragon).
Graydle Slime Jr. (Level 2 Tuner) revives a Graydle from your GY on Normal Summon and Special Summons an Aqua with the same Level from hand, fielding 3 monsters off 1 Normal Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Graydle Slime Jr.
steps: Normal Summon Graydle Slime Jr. with a Level 3 Graydle (Alligator, Cobra, or Eagle) in your GY and another in hand.
Activate Slime Jr.'s on-summon effect to Special Summon the Level 3 Graydle from your GY.
Special Summon the second Level 3 Graydle from your hand with Slime Jr.'s secondary effect.
Synchro Summon Level 8 Graydle Dragon using Level 2 Tuner Slime Jr. and both Level 3 non-Tuners.
Graydle Dragon triggers on summon to target and destroy 3 cards your opponent controls (1 per WATER material used).

summary.title: Self-Destruction Triggers & Spells
points: Graydle Impact is the central engine Spell: once per turn, it destroys 1 Graydle card you control and 1 opponent card (triggering Alligator to steal a monster), or searches any Graydle card during your End Phase.
Graydle Slime destroys 2 Graydle cards you control to Special Summon itself from hand or GY (triggering Graydle Eagle's steal), then revives a Graydle to Synchro Summon Graydle Dragon.
Graydle Split is a Normal Trap that sends the equipped monster to the GY to Special Summon 2 differently named Graydles from your Deck (triggering Cobra upon being sent by a Trap).
Supply Squad draws 1 card each turn whenever a Graydle monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Graydle Dragon (Level 8 Synchro, 3000 ATK) destroys opponent cards on summon up to the number of WATER monsters used for its summon, and revives any other WATER monster from your GY if destroyed.
White Aura Whale wipes all opponent Attack Position monsters on summon, attacks twice on monsters, inflicts piercing damage, and revives itself from the GY as a Tuner.
Graydle Combat is a Counter Trap that either negates an effect targeting a Graydle or changes that effect into Destroy that monster to trigger its theft.
Marincess Coral Anemone revives any Graydle from your GY to re-trigger plays or link climb.

allow.Supply Squad: Continuous Spell that draws 1 card once per turn whenever a Graydle monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect.

allow.Coral Dragon: Level 6 WATER Synchro Tuner made with Level 3 Graydle Slime Jr. + Level 3 Graydle that pops a card and draws 1 when climbing into Graydle Dragon.
allow.Marincess Coral Anemone: Link-2 WATER monster that revives any Graydle monster from the GY.

main: Graydle Alligator
Level 3 WATER Aqua: when destroyed by battle OR by a Spell effect (such as Graydle Impact!) and sent to the GY, equips to 1 face-up monster your opponent controls and takes control of it.
Graydle Cobra
Level 3 WATER Aqua: when destroyed by battle OR by a Trap effect (such as Graydle Split!) and sent to the GY, equips to 1 face-up monster your opponent controls and takes control of it.
Graydle Eagle

Level 3 WATER Aqua: when destroyed by battle OR by a Monster effect (such as Graydle Dragon or Graydle Slime!) and sent to the GY, equips to 1 face-up monster your opponent controls and takes control of it.
Graydle Slime Jr.

Core Level 2 WATER Aqua Tuner: revives 1 'Graydle' monster from your GY when Normal Summoned, then Special Summons 1 Aqua monster with the same Level from your hand (assembling Level 2 + 3 + 3 = Level 8 Graydle Dragon in 1 Normal Summon!), and summons a Graydle from Deck when destroyed by battle.
Graydle Slime

Level 5 WATER Aqua Tuner: destroys 2 'Graydle' cards you control (triggering Graydle Eagle via its Monster effect!) to Special Summon itself from hand or GY, then revives 1 Graydle monster from your GY to immediately Synchro Summon Level 8 Graydle Dragon!
Graydle Impact

Core Continuous Spell: either destroys 1 other Graydle card you control (triggering Graydle Alligator via Spell destruction!) and 1 card your opponent controls, OR searches any 'Graydle' card from your Deck during your End Phase.
Graydle Split

Normal Trap: equips to a monster you control for +500 ATK, then sends the equipped monster to the GY during your Main Phase to Special Summon 2 'Graydle' monsters with different names directly from your Deck!
Graydle Parasite

Continuous Trap: Special Summons 1 Graydle monster from your Deck in Attack Position if your opponent declares a direct attack while you control no monsters, and revives a monster from the opponent's GY if a Graydle attacks directly.
Graydle Combat

Counter Trap: when a Spell/Trap or monster effect is activated that targets exactly 1 Graydle monster you control, either changes that effect into 'Destroy that monster' (triggering your Graydle's steal effect!) OR negates and destroys the activation.
Surface
Revives Graydle Slime Jr. or any Level 3 Graydle from the GY.
Supply Squad
Draws 1 card each turn when your Graydles are destroyed by battle or Graydle Impact.
